title: Create App Pre-Registration ads
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create App Pre-Registration ads. # Introduction App Pre-Registration is a type of app promotion that encourages users to register ahead of a game's launch, allowing for automatic downloads of the app on launch day. By leveraging App Pre-Registration, you can build a user base for the game ahead of its launch, generate publicity and awareness, and build momentum to create a vibrant community on the TikTok platform. **You can use Campaign Management API to create App Pre-Registration ads, and this helps you streamline your ad creation experience, and elevate operational efficiency and scalability.** # Prerequisites - You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713609895937) for details. - To create App Pre-Registration Ads, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855280338946) to find out how to configure permissions. - App Pre-Registration is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. # Steps ## 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). Note that the following requirements must be met.
Setting Requirement Parameter How to configure the parameter
Advertising objective App promotion objective_type APP_PROMOTION
App promotion type App pre-registration app_promotion_type APP_PREREGISTRATION
iOS 14 Dedicated Campaign Disabled campaign_type Set to REGULAR_CAMPAIGN or not passed.
app_id Not passed
campaign_app_profile_page_state Not passed
Smart+ Campaign Disabled

If you are not sure about whether the campaign is Smart+ Campaign, you can use the is_smart_performance_campaign field returned from /campaign/get/ to check.		 /
 /
### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "objective_type": "APP_PROMOTION", "app_promotion_type": "APP_PREREGISTRATION", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "budget_mode":"BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget": {{budget}} }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "app_promotion_type": "APP_PREREGISTRATION", "is_new_structure": true, "deep_bid_type": null, "modify_time": "2023-07-24 02:55:32", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "create_time": "2023-07-24 02:55:32", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "roas_bid": 0, "budget": {{budget}}, "campaign_app_profile_page_state": "UNSET", "objective_type": "APP_PROMOTION", "operation_status": "ENABLE", "secondary_status": "CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLE", "objective": "LANDING_PAGE", "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "is_smart_performance_campaign": false, "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}" } } (/code) ``` ## 2. Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114). Note that the following requirements must be met. ``` xtable | Setting{20%} | Requirement{25%} | Parameter{20%} | How to configure the parameter{35%} | |---|---|---| | Promotion type
(Optimization location) | One of the following types:
  • Website
  • TikTok Instant Page
| `promotion_type`
`promotion_website_type` |
  • To specify promotion type as Website:
    • Set `promotion_type` to `WEBSITE`
    • Set `promotion_website_type` to `UNSET` or do not pass this field
  • To specify promotion type as TikTok Instant Page:
    • Set `promotion_type` to `WEBSITE`
    • Set `promotion_website_type` to `TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE`
| | App | Specify an app that users can pre-register for. | `app_id` | Pass a valid value | | Optimization event | Specified.

Note: When promotion type is TikTok Instant Page, the only supported optimization event is Click Button. | `optimization_event` | Specified.

Note: When `promotion_website_type` is set to `TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE`, this field can only be set to `BUTTON`.| | Pixel |

  • Required when Promotion type is Website.
  • Not supported when Promotion type is TikTok Instant Page.
| `pixel_id` |
  • Required when `promotion_website_type` is set to `UNSET` or not passed.
  • Not supported when `promotion_website_type` is set to `TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE`.
| | Placement | When promotion type is TikTok Instant Page, the placement should at least include TikTok or Pangle | `placement_type`
`placements` | When `promotion_website_type` is set to `TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE`, you can either:
  • set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`
  • OR set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and include at least `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` or `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` in the value of `placements`
| | Optimization goal | Only Conversion is supported. | `optimization_goal` | `CONVERT` | | Billing event | Only oCPM is supported. | `billing_event` | `OCPM` | | Pre-bid brand safety filtering
(Inventory filter) | Disabled | `brand_safety_type` | Not passed or set to `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` | | Pre-bid brand safety filtering | Disabled | `brand_safety_partner` | Not passed| | Split test | Disabled

Therefore, App Pre-Registration ad groups cannot be used in [/split_test/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1742666471475201) to create split tests. | / | / | ``` ### Example - Create an ad Create an ad using [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354). Note that the following requirements must be met. ``` xtable | Setting{15%} | Requirement{25%} | Parameter{18%} | How to configure the parameter{42%} | |---|---|---| | Destination |
  • If promotion type is specified as Website at the ad group level, a landing page URL must be specified.
  • If promotion type is specified as TikTok Instant Page at the ad group level, a TikTok Instant Page must be specified.
| `landing_page_url`
`page_id`
`creative_type` |
  • If `promotion_website_type` is set to `UNSET` or not passed at the ad group level, you need to pass in `landing_page_url`.
  • If `promotion_website_type` is set to `TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE` at the ad group level, you need to specify a TikTok Instant Page through `page_id`.

| | Deeplink | Disabled | `deeplink`
